versions.changelog:
Initial public release: fast and structured collection of Douyin (TikTok China) public data for research, competitor analysis, trend tracking, and content evaluation.

- Supports four core commands: keyword search, account posts fetch, video comments fetch, and real-time trending topics.
- Automatic scenario recognition and intent mapping for flexible triggering (even without explicit "Douyin" mention).
- Strict token management and error handling for compliance and reliability.
- Output is structured JSON; logs and errors handled per specification.
- Chinese language interface, for compliant, legal, internal data research only.
